title: Agnew Bahnson's plane crash

tellings.quote: he dies a couple of years later in a bizarre plane crash which to this day his family thinks, you know, he was killed essentially

plain: A man named Agnew Bahnson died in what Michels calls "a bizarre plane crash" a couple of years after the events Michels is describing, in the early 1960s, and Michels says Bahnson's family still believes he was essentially killed. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, in an episode about UFO secrecy and a secret society. If the family is right, someone close to the UFO question would have been silenced.
